user.title: Connect GitHub
user.description:
Create a personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens and choose what to track.

**Profile** works for public activity with any token. A classic token with `repo` and `read:org` also shows contributions in private repositories; a fine-grained token only sees one owner and cannot access Packages.

**Repositories** needs read access to the repositories you add later (fine-grained: Metadata, Contents, Issues, Pull requests and Actions).
